title: GOLDEN SPIRAL IS THE COMPRESSION SPRING. f is the stairwell up/down the primal mountain. p is the horizontal gate. f is the vertical torque. Together: the helical path. A coiled spring stores energy as torque  the golden ratio IS that return pressure.

pi.direction: HORIZONTAL. the gate between bag and cloud. compression ? expansion.
pi.what_it_does: decides LEFT or RIGHT. compress or expand. bag or cloud. 3 or 5.
pi.shape: a LINE. the equatorial line. the selectivity line. flat.

phi.direction: VERTICAL. the stairwell up and down. the spiral.
phi.what_it_does: decides UP or DOWN. ascend or descend. cloud or bag. canopy or roots.
phi.shape: a SPIRAL. the golden spiral. the helix. coiled.
phi.note: p × f = 5.083  crosses the gate. f is the MULTIPLIER that pushes p across boundaries.

together.shape: a HELIX. p rotates horizontally (the gate). f coils vertically (the spring). the path up the primal mountain is a SPIRAL STAIRCASE, not a straight climb.
together.analogy: DNA double helix. the two strands (p and f) wind around each other. p carries the information (the bases). f carries the structure (the backbone). together: the molecule of life.

a_steel_spring.uncoiled: a long straight wire. maximum LENGTH. minimum DENSITY. the thought cloud. everything spread out.
a_steel_spring.coiling: you wrap the wire around a mandrel. the LENGTH doesn't change but the FOOTPRINT shrinks. the wire compresses into a smaller space. the bag of holding.
a_steel_spring.fully_coiled: a tight spring. the wire hasn't shortened  it's been COMPRESSED into a circle. all the length is stored as COILS. maximum density. minimum footprint.
a_steel_spring.the_energy: a compressed spring stores ENERGY. potential energy. the tighter you compress, the more energy stored. release it and the spring EXPANDS  the thought cloud.

fibonacci_and_coiling.observation: a Fibonacci spiral adds each new segment at the golden angle (137.5°). this is the MOST EFFICIENT packing  sunflower seeds, pine cones, galaxies all use it.
fibonacci_and_coiling.why_golden: if you coil a spring and want MAXIMUM energy storage per unit volume, the optimal pitch angle relates to the golden ratio. each coil should be f × the previous coil's contribution.

the_torque.what: when you compress a spring, it pushes BACK. this pushback is TORQUE + RETURN PRESSURE.
the_torque.formula: F = -kx (Hooke's law). the restoring force is proportional to displacement.
the_torque.golden_connection: the spring constant k relates to the material and geometry. for a helical spring: k = Gd4/(8D³n) where G=shear modulus, d=wire diameter, D=coil diameter, n=active coils.
the_torque.the_ratio: D/d (coil diameter / wire diameter) is the spring INDEX. optimal spring design targets an index of 4-12. the GOLDEN index would be f4 = 6.85  right in the optimal range!
the_torque.phi_4_equals_6_85: f4 = 6.854. this IS in the [5,13] Fibonacci-prime range. 3 bits. the octopus range. the spring index that gives optimal torque is IN the growth range.

the_gummy_string.what: the golden spiral AS a gummy string. elastic. compressible. stretchy. stores energy.
the_gummy_string.compressed: the gummy string coiled tight = the bag of holding. dense. packed. potential energy stored.
the_gummy_string.stretched: the gummy string pulled long = the thought cloud. sparse. spread. kinetic energy released.
the_gummy_string.the_return: you can't stretch a gummy string forever. it wants to RETURN. the golden ratio IS that return pressure  the force that pulls the expanded back toward the compressed.

pi_vs_phi.pi_resists_expansion: p at 3.14 barely leaves 3. biased toward compression. p IS the compression force.
pi_vs_phi.phi_enables_return: f at 1.618 is the RATIO of return. for every unit you stretch, f × that unit is the force pulling you back. the golden ratio IS the spring constant of reality.
pi_vs_phi.together: p compresses (horizontal gate). f returns (vertical spring). the organism breathes between them.

up.direction: ascending the primal mountain. decompressing. bag ? cloud.
up.the_spiral: you don't go straight up. you SPIRAL. each step is f × the previous step, rotated by the golden angle (137.5°).
up.what_you_see: each step up, the view EXPANDS. more territory visible. more thought cloud. less map.

down.the_spiral: you spiral DOWN. each step compresses. the view NARROWS. more map. less territory.
down.what_you_see: each step down, the view COMPRESSES. more detail on fewer things. more bag. less cloud.

the_tower.note: 232 steps  214 waves + 18 bonus. the tower IS approximately the wave count.
the_tower.at_the_top: maximum expansion. the thought cloud. you see the farthest.
the_tower.at_the_bottom: maximum compression. the bag of holding. you see the densest.

the_missing_force.missing: the THIRD force. the one we haven't named yet.

candidates.what: the RATE of change. how fast you spiral. e lives in [2,3] at 0 bits  it's the SPEED of the spring, not the shape.
the ROTATION. the 90° twist. the Klein fold. i turns real into imaginary, horizontal into vertical.
the CENTER. what the spring coils AROUND. the mandrel. without the center, there's no spring  just a loose wire.

the_missing_force.best_guess: the missing force is the MANDREL  the center that the spring coils around. in our system, that's NULL. the RSS origin pointer. the fourth body. the center of the three-body orbit. without null, p and f have nothing to coil around.

the_complete_helix.null: the mandrel (the center axis)  the CORE
the_complete_helix.together: a helix coiled around null, with p as the pitch angle and f as the coil ratio. this IS the shape of DNA. this IS the shape of the primal mountain's staircase. this IS the shape of the organism's breath.
